titulo: The GTA VI ‘extended look’ is now streaming on YouTube
cuerpo: Rockstar has officially published its "extended look" at Grand Theft Auto VI on YouTube and on its website, as promised. The in-depth preview, which "entirely" features footage captured from the PS5 version of the game, initially premiered on Netflix at 3PM ET.
